0022600102.text: The Lakers host the LA Clippers in the second game of the Lakers' 2026-27 season, and neither team has played a game this season yet. The teams split their four 2025-26 meetings 2-2, and the most recent meeting, on February 20, 2026 in Los Angeles, went the Lakers' way 125-122. The Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee), Cameron Carr (oblique strain) and Collin Sexton (calf), while the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery).
